query:
INSERT INTO system_prompts.session_prompts
                    (session_id, request_id, lane, subagent_persona, blocks, content_sha256)
                 SELECT $1, $2, 'subagent', $3, $4, $5
                 WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM system_prompts.session_prompts WHERE request_id = $2
                 )
